import requests

BASE_URL = "https://claims.test"


def load_day(day):
    response = requests.get(BASE_URL + "/claims", params={"day": day}, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["items"]

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://claims.test"


def load_day(day):
    response = requests.get(BASE_URL + "/claims/count", params={"day": day}, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["items"]
